label.en: What field work is recommended today?
label.rw: Ni ibihe bikorwa by'umurima byemewe uyu munsi?

answer.en:
Millimetres come from OpenWeatherMap.

We then label 24-hour rain like this:
• 0 mm — No rain (Ntamvura)
• above 0 and under 1 mm — Trace (Akayira)
• 1 to under 5 mm — Light rain (Imvura nke)
• 5 to under 20 mm — Moderate rain (Imvura iringaniye)
• 20 to 50 mm — Heavy rain (Imvura nyinshi)
• above 50 mm — Very heavy rain (Imvura nyinshi cyane)

We do not pull a live Meteo Rwanda data feed.
answer.rw:
Milimetero zikoma ku OpenWeatherMap.

Hanyuma dushyiraho amagambo y'imvura y'amasaha 24:
• mm 0 — Ntamvura
• hejuru ya 0 munsi ya 1 — Akayira
• mm 1 kugeza munsi ya 5 — Imvura nke
• mm 5 kugeza munsi ya 20 — Imvura iringaniye
• mm 20 kugeza 50 — Imvura nyinshi
• hejuru ya mm 50 — Imvura nyinshi cyane

Ntiturafata amakuru y'ikirere aturuka kuri Meteo Rwanda.

answer.en:
The days list on Forecasts is the OpenWeatherMap short-range forecast (about 3–8 days, more if the subscription allows).

Typical forecast ranges:
• Nowcasting — minutes to about 2 hours
• Short-range — 3 hours to 3 days
• Medium-range — 3 days to under 10 days
• Longer outlooks — 10–30 days, monthly, or seasonal

That list is not a seasonal bulletin.
answer.rw:
Urutonde rw'iminsi kuri Iteganyagihe ni iteganyagihe rigufi rya OpenWeatherMap (iminsi 3–8, cyangwa irenzeho niba subscription yemera).

Igihe gisanzwe:
• Ako kanya — iminota kugeza hafi amasaha 2
• Rigufi — amasaha 3 kugeza iminsi 3
• Riringaniye — iminsi 3 kugeza munsi y'iminsi 10
• Iriendeire — iminsi 10–30, ukwezi, cyangwa igihembwe

Urwo rutonde si iteganyagihe ry'igihembwe.

answer.en:
Live weather (rain millimetres, chance of rain, temperature, humidity, wind, clouds) comes from OpenWeatherMap, through our backend.

This app does not fetch a Meteo Rwanda API. Short rain labels (light, moderate, heavy) are only names we put on those OpenWeather millimetres.
answer.rw:
Ikirere kiriho (milimetero z'imvura, amahirwe y'imvura, ubushyuhe, ubuhehere, umuyaga, ibicu) gikoma ku OpenWeatherMap, binyuze ku backend yacu.

Iyi porogaramu ntiifata API ya Meteo Rwanda. Amagambo magufi (imvura nke, iringaniye, nyinshi) ni amazina dushyira kuri izo milimetero za OpenWeather.

answer.en: Say soil moisture only when you have a field check or a validated estimate — not from the sky forecast alone. Use the Soil suitability page for crop suitability maps in Musanze. After heavy rain, wait for the surface to firm before spraying or walking wet fields.
answer.rw: Vuga ubuhehere bw'ubutaka gusa iyo wagenzuye umurima cyangwa ufite ikigereranyo cyemewe — ntukivane ku kirere gusa. Koresha Isesengura ry'Ubutaka ku ikarita y'ibihingwa i Musanze. Nyuma y'imvura nyinshi, tegereza ubutaka gukomera mbere yo gufuka cyangwa kugenda mu mirima.
